name: Elena Karamanou
bio: Elena Karamanou is a Postdoctoral Researcher at CPSSec. Her work centers on intrusion detection in industrial IoT systems, combining machine learning with physics-based models for anomaly detection in CPS environments. She previously worked on cyber-physical security for maritime systems.
shortBio: Postdoctoral researcher working on ML-based intrusion detection for IIoT.
